author: Stahly
description:
Part 2 of our big Space Marines review turns to the character side of this release wave: the long-awaited Captain on bike, finally giving mounted commanders their due, and Kaius Koronius, the Ultramarines' new blademaster stepping in where Uriel Ventris left off. We unbox both kits, walk through every build option, and share the full 4K unboxing video alongside high-res sprue images.

The post Space Marines Captain on Bike and Kaius Koronius review: worth the wait? appeared first on Tale of Painters.
title: Space Marines Captain on Bike and Kaius Koronius review: worth the wait?
